concept.title: Step 1: gather and clean
concept.shortdesc: A harvesting program collects the listings from every directory, tidies them and removes personal details.

conbody.p: A harvesting program collects the listings from every directory and converts them into one common shape. As it does so, it:

ul.li: strips out web formatting and repeated boilerplate
removes personal contact details, such as a named person's phone number or email address, so that these never reach an AI model
spots the same service appearing in more than one directory, and links the copies together
